name: World Health Organization
body: WHO welcomes AI answer crawlers and its pages read well without JavaScript: GEO 91. But the JSON-LD on its fact sheets ends in "};", and a strict parser drops the whole block.
lesson: Run every JSON-LD block through a JSON validator before release. One character can void the entire block.
summary: www.who.int scores 77 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: 11 JSON-LD blocks do not parse.

fix.title: 11 JSON-LD blocks do not parse
fix.evidence: On /southeastasia, /news-room/fact-sheets/detail/dengue-and-severe-dengue, /news-room/fact-sheets/detail/endometriosis, /news-room/fact-sheets/detail/climate-change-heat-and-health and 3 more. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI…
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

fix.title: 12 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /health-topics, /health-topics/, /multi-media, /news-room/questions-and-answers. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages read.

fix.title: 7 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /resources, /news-room/fact-sheets, /news-room/facts-in-pictures, /multi-media and 3 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 16 internal links go through a redirect
fix.evidence: /europe/ → /europe/home?v=welcome, /mega-menu/health-topics → /health-topics, /mega-menu/health-topics/resources → /resources, /mega-menu/health-topics/resources/fact-sheets → /news-room/fact-sheets. Each hop costs crawl budget and a little speed.
fix.fix: Point the links straight at the final address.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 158 ms
